children: Sharma joins Godrej Properties’ West Zone team in Pune after serving as Senior Manager – Marketing at Gera Developments
Godrej Properties appoints Dishant Sharma as Manager – Marketing for its West Zone operations, based in Pune.
Sharma joins Godrej Properties after serving as Senior Manager – Marketing at Gera Developments. He previously worked with Godrej Properties from 2020 to 2025 before moving to Gera Developments.

His experience spans business-to-business (B2B) and business-to-consumer (B2C) marketing and planning, product management, digital marketing, advertising sales, online reputation management, corporate social responsibility, public relations and new media.
Sharma also has experience across marketing, technology and innovation, along with a background in business communication. Earlier in his career, he worked with Kanakia Group and NDTV.
